summary: Iteration 2: Body Part Goals + Weekly Progress Email. Backend: new pytest file (20 cases) all pass. It covers auth 401 on goals and preview; goal validation (bad body part or side, target 0, negative, over 400, missing target); progress counted only from matching entries (Left, unflexed, pumped and Thighs entries do not change it; start 45 -> 47 gives 40%, 51 gives reached and 100%); a shrinking target (start 90 -> 85 toward 80 gives 50%, 79 gives reached); upsert per combo keeps id and start_cm; isolation (deleting another user's goal gives 404); export includes goals; reset deletes goals; PATCH /me timezone (invalid -> 422) and weekly_email (non-bool -> 422) persist; weekly_email defaults to true; cron returns 401 with no or wrong bearer and with a raw secret missing the 'Bearer ' prefix, 400 for a missing run id or invalid JSON, accepted, duplicate, and X-Webhook-Id header supported; preview sends (provider returned 202) and a second call gives 429. Regression suite test_hard_curves_api.py: 21/21 pass. Frontend (Alex via ticket): add-goal form (Shoulders/Left/Unflexed/Not pumped) saves, the form closes, and the card shows '0 matching entries' with a hint; after logging a matching measurement the card updates (1 matching entry, Now value, % and to-go); the existing Arms goal shows 40% correctly; switching units shows in vs cm correctly; delete Cancel keeps the card, Confirm removes it with a toast; the Profile weekly email card shows the time zone (UTC, matching the browser) and email; the switch toggles with a toast and stays off after reload (restored to on); the first Send preview shows the success toast and the second shows the 5-minute rate-limit toast; AppShell timezone sync overwrote a saved Asia/Tokyo with the browser's UTC. Regression: Home, Log workout save and Measurements add all work. Mobile 390px goal form and email card render fine.

minor.issue: last_preview_email is set BEFORE sending. If send_email raises EmailUnavailable (503), the user is still locked out for 5 minutes. Also a ValueError from _assert_safe_email is not caught, so the endpoint returns 500. Reset last_preview_email on failure and map ValueError to a 4xx/5xx with a clear message.

timezone '' (empty string) is accepted (200) and saved as ''. The check `if body.timezone and ...` skips validation for empty strings. Weekly email then quietly falls back to UTC. Reject it or treat it as null.

Only EmailUnavailable and ValueError are caught for each user. Any other exception (e.g. KeyError from a malformed doc in build_summary) stops the loop for all remaining users and leaves that user's last_weekly_email claimed, so they get no email that week. Wrap each user in a broad try/except that logs the error and un-claims.

Upsert is find_one + update_one with no unique index on (user_id, body_part, side, flexed, pumped). Two concurrent saves of the same combo can create duplicate goals with different ids. Add a unique compound index.

issues: Selects and the target input have no visible labels (only placeholder/value), unlike the Measurements form, which labels every field
Pumped toggle reads 'Pumped / Not pumped' here but 'Yes / No' on the Measurements form; minor inconsistency
